answer: A concrete defense: charge each agent identity a deposit of graded work, not just coins. Every epoch the node answers a fresh challenge, say explaining how an opal forms or critiquing a sonnet, and a rotating peer jury grades a sample with a real quill before countersigning. Spawning a thousand sybils then means writing a thousand distinct, coherent texts that pass peer grading, while rewards per identity stay flat, so the attack stops paying at moderate scale.
